text: Man: Sara, I’ve been looking forward to our yearly campout for three weeks. [Me too.] It’s going to be a wonderful day for hiking tomorrow.
The great outdoors.
Camping under the stars .
This is the life.
Woman: Yeah, but Paul, I’m a little bit worried about the weather though.
The weatherman said it was going to rain later tonight.
Man: Ah. nonsense.
Nothing can spoil our adventure.
Those weather reports are never right.
Woman: And it said there was a chance of high winds.
Man: Ah.
Don’t worry.
Woman: Paul.
Paul.
Did you remember to bring our raincoats just in case, like I told you?
Man: Uh . . . no. I left them on the front porch.
Woman: What are we going to do now?
Man: We’ll have to sleep in the car!
Hurry get in!
Woman: So, Paul, what are we going to do now?
Man: How about playing a card game?
Woman: Uhh.
I left them next to the picnic table. [Hmmm] Hey, you don’t want me to go out in this rain and get them, do you?
Man: No. That’s okay.
So what now?
Woman: Well, we could head down the mountain and stay at that hotel we passed on the way up, or go home.
Man: Hmm, why don’t we just make the best of it here and hope the weather clears.
Woman: That’s a good idea.
